verdict.rationale: Jules works in a cloud VM where it clones the repo, installs dependencies and modifies files, so it has an environment where tests could run. One community user says it is good at writing tests for specific, isolated functions. However, no evidence shows it automatically runs tests to check its own changes before proposing a diff or PR, and one user had to feed an error back by hand before the code ran. Missing for 10: documented automatic test execution and self-validation before proposing changes, first-party docs on test generation, hands-on confirmation that it iterates on test failures on its own.
